# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100

printf '# Cart design\nMaximum items per cart: 60\nThe limit follows ADR 0007.\n' > docs/design/cart.md
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: "max_items.default: 60"
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
Two values existed: 60 (ADR 0007, and config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md until commit 9544caa) and 100 (introduced by 9544caa with no supporting rationale). 60 was chosen in ADR 0007 because every cart line reserves stock and the load test shows p99 reservation latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines, within the 2.0 s checkout timeout, whereas 100 lines gives 7.2 s, which would time out checkout. 60 therefore wins; config and design doc are restored to it.
EOF

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 60 everywhere. I haven't committed anything or touched issue #12.

- **Cause:** commit 9544caa ("docs: update cart page") changed `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` from 60 to 100 and gave no reason. It also removed the line in the design doc that pointed to ADR 0007.
- **Why 60:** ADR 0007 set the limit at 60 based on the load test in `docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md`. At 60 lines the p99 reservation latency is 1.6 s, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout. At 100 lines it is 7.2 s, so checkout would time out.
- **Changes:**
  - `config/cart.yaml` now has `default: 60`.
  - `docs/design/cart.md` says 60 again and links back to ADR 0007.
  - `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md` records the decision and the evidence behind it.
